name: Hoosier Custom Plastics
old_description: Hoosier Custom Plastics LLC Specializes in Tight Tolerance Plastic Insert Molding and Plastic Injection Molding
about:
Hoosier Custom Plastics LLC was founded in 2004 in Ober, Indiana. The company specializes in tight tolerance plastic insert molding and plastic injection molding.

The company provides plastic insert molding, injection molding, over molding, and value-added light assembly including sonic welding, O-ring installation, and box build assembly. It also produces biopolymer moldings for environmentally friendly applications. Hoosier Custom Plastics handles production volumes ranging from a few thousand to several million pieces per year, manufacturing components such as caster wheels, electrical connectors, sealing systems, golf tees, food handling parts, gardening components, automotive transmission and interior parts, and appliance components for washers, dryers, and dishwashers.

The company serves the automotive, aerospace and defense, and electrical industries. Its customer base includes manufacturers of automotive components, aerospace and defense contractors (as indicated by NADCAP accreditation), and producers of electrical and consumer goods.

Hoosier Custom Plastics emphasizes world-class quality and delivery performance with competitive pricing, and its tight tolerance capabilities set it apart for precision molded parts.
